modelAtelier.name: The Sorting Hat · One Cloth Mesh
modelAtelier.reference: One original editable connected cloth mesh. Eyes are dents, NOT holes; eyebrows, nose and talking-mouth recess are sculpted into the same surface, with UV-painted shadows and wrinkles. Upright tip and watertight rear seam, double-sided wavy brim, lining and rear repair cloth are all regions of this sole mesh. Source: owner-supplied Sorting Hat sketch and multi-view fabric study. The v11.483 49-object assembly remains backed up in Git history/scene.
